      "section": "tome-cults/data/general/events/space-dwarf-ship.lua",
      "source": "The thing in front of you appears to be a strange dome made from green glass. Judging by the crater around it, this dome must have crashed into the earth with tremendous force. Stranger still is the figure seated inside it. It appears to be wearing a suit made of an unknown material and a glass dome over its head. Looking inside the dome, you can plainly see that the figure is a dwarf! There is no mistaking that oversized nose. Judging by the smell, he has been dead for quite some time.\n\nYou are fairly sure that the dwarves aren't capable of making something like this and they definitely don't dress like that. So, where did this odd dwarf come from? Taking a closer look, you find a strange device attached to the dwarf's arm. You remove it with no small amount of effort. It is completely unlike anything you have seen before and you're not really sure what to make of it. Perhaps if you hold onto it, you might be able to discern its functionality later.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "出现在你眼前的是一个由绿色玻璃制成的奇怪圆顶。根据周围的坑判断，这个圆顶一定是以巨大的力量撞进地面的。更奇怪的是坐在里面的身影：它似乎穿着一套不明材质的服装，头上罩着一个玻璃罩。透过圆顶往里看，你清楚地看出这个身影是一个矮人！那个硕大的鼻子绝不会认错。从气味判断，他已经死了很久了。\n\n你很肯定矮人造不出这样的东西，而且他们绝对不会这样穿衣服。那么，这个奇怪的矮人是从哪里来的？仔细观察，你发现矮人的手臂上附着一个奇怪的装置。你费了不小的力气才把它取下来。它和你见过的任何东西都不一样，你也不太确定它是什么。如果你留着它，也许以后能弄清它的用途。"
